mapper.sql: JOIN automation_ui_scene s ON s.id = e.scene_id AND s.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_config p ON p.id = s.project_id AND p.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_version_config pv ON pv.id = s.version_id AND pv.project_id = s.project_id AND pv.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_module_config pm ON pm.id = s.module_id AND pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.version_id = s.version_id AND pm.del_flag = 3

choose.when: AND ( e.record_source = 'debug' OR ( e.record_source IS NULL AND (e.record_type IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(e.record_type)) NOT IN ('internal-interactive-context', 'interactive-execution-context')) AND e.test_plan_id IS NULL AND e.test_report_id IS NULL AND (e.trigger_type IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(e.trigger_type)) NOT IN ('test-plan', 'schedule')) ) )
choose.otherwise: AND ( e.record_source = 'test' OR ( e.record_source IS NULL AND (e.record_type IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(e.record_type)) NOT IN ('internal-interactive-context', 'interactive-execution-context')) AND ( e.test_plan_id IS NOT NULL OR e.test_report_id IS NOT NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(e.trigger_type)) IN ('test-plan', 'schedule') ) ) )

mapper.sql: COALESCE(e.record_source, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(e.record_type)) IN ('internal-interactive-context', 'interactive-execution-context') THEN 'internal' WHEN e.test_plan_id IS NOT NULL OR e.test_report_id IS NOT NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(e.trigger_type)) IN ('test-plan', 'schedule') THEN 'test' ELSE 'debug' END) AS record_source

e.id AS execution_db_id, e.execution_key, e.scene_id AS scene_db_id, e.scene_key, e.batch_id, , e.test_plan_id, e.test_report_id, e.build_number, e.record_type, e.trigger_type, e.execution_engine, e.status, e.result, e.execute_user_id, e.execute_username, e.execute_name, e.execute_email, e.project_environment_id, e.project_environment_name, e.case_total, e.case_pass, e.case_fail, e.case_skip, e.case_cancelled, e.step_total, e.step_pass, e.step_fail, e.step_skip, e.started_at, e.finished_at, COALESCE( NULLIF(e.duration_ms, 0), CASE WHEN e.started_at IS NOT NULL AND e.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, e.started_at, e.finished_at) / 1000 ELSE ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE( NULLIF(cw.wall_clock_duration_ms, 0), NULLIF(cw.duration_ms, 0), CASE WHEN cw.started_at IS NOT NULL AND cw.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, cw.started_at, cw.finished_at) / 1000 ELSE 0 END )), 0) FROM automation_ui_execution_case cw WHERE cw.execution_id = e.id ) END, 0 ) AS duration_ms, e.error_code, LEFT(e.error_message, 512) AS error_message, e.create_time, e.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS scene_db_id, COALESCE(es.execution_revision, 0) AS global_execution_revision FROM automation_ui_scene s JOIN project_config p ON p.id = s.project_id AND p.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_version_config pv ON pv.id = s.version_id AND pv.project_id = s.project_id AND pv.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_module_config pm ON pm.id = s.module_id AND pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.version_id = s.version_id AND pm.del_flag = 3 LEFT JOIN automation_ui_scene_execution_state es ON es.scene_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{sceneDbId} AND s.del_flag = 3

SELECT FROM ( SELECT candidate.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY candidate.scene_id ORDER BY candidate.create_time DESC, candidate.id DESC ) AS scoped_rank FROM automation_ui_execution candidate WHERE candidate.scene_id IN
#{sceneDbId}
AND ( candidate.record_source = 'debug' OR ( candidate.record_source IS NULL AND (candidate.record_type IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(candidate.record_type)) NOT IN ('internal-interactive-context', 'interactive-execution-context')) AND candidate.test_plan_id IS NULL AND candidate.test_report_id IS NULL AND (candidate.trigger_type IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(candidate.trigger_type)) NOT IN ('test-plan', 'schedule')) ) )
AND ( candidate.record_source = 'test' OR ( candidate.record_source IS NULL AND (candidate.record_type IS NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(candidate.record_type)) NOT IN ('internal-interactive-context', 'interactive-execution-context')) AND ( candidate.test_plan_id IS NOT NULL OR candidate.test_report_id IS NOT NULL OR LOWER(TRIM(candidate.trigger_type)) IN ('test-plan', 'schedule') ) ) )
AND candidate.test_plan_id = #{scope.testPlanId} AND candidate.test_report_id = #{scope.testReportId} AND candidate.build_number = #{scope.buildNumber} ) e
WHERE e.scoped_rank = 1
ORDER BY e.scene_id

SELECT s.id AS scene_db_id, COALESCE(es.execution_revision, 0) AS global_execution_revision, COUNT(e.id) AS total FROM automation_ui_scene s JOIN project_config p ON p.id = s.project_id AND p.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_version_config pv ON pv.id = s.version_id AND pv.project_id = s.project_id AND pv.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_module_config pm ON pm.id = s.module_id AND pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.version_id = s.version_id AND pm.del_flag = 3 LEFT JOIN automation_ui_scene_execution_state es ON es.scene_id = s.id LEFT JOIN automation_ui_execution e ON e.scene_id = s.id
AND e.status = #{query.status} AND e.result = #{query.result} WHERE s.id = #{query.sceneDbId} AND s.del_flag = 3
GROUP BY s.id, es.execution_revision

SELECT , e.definition_revision_id, e.console_url, e.test_report_url, e.executor_node, e.heartbeat_at, e.lease_until, e.cancel_requested FROM automation_ui_execution e
WHERE e.id = #{executionDbId}
mapper.sql: c.id AS case_execution_db_id, c.execution_id AS execution_db_id, c.case_id AS definition_case_id, c.case_key, c.case_execution_key, c.case_name, c.case_index, c.attempt_no, c.job_id, c.status, c.result, c.execute_status, c.execute_result, c.step_total, c.step_pass, c.step_fail, c.step_skip, c.started_at, c.finished_at, c.duration_ms, c.step_duration_ms, c.wall_clock_duration_ms, c.error_code, LEFT(c.error_message, 512) AS error_message, c.event_sequence, c.create_time, c.update_time

st.id AS step_execution_db_id, st.execution_case_id AS case_execution_db_id, st.step_id AS definition_step_id, st.source_step_id, st.step_index, st.attempt_no, st.action_type, st.step_name, st.description, st.status, st.duration_ms, st.locator_source, st.locator_type, st.error_code, LEFT(st.error_message, 512) AS error_message, st.event_sequence, st.create_time, st.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT , st.locator_value, st.diagnostics FROM automation_ui_execution_step st JOIN automation_ui_execution_case c ON c.id = st.execution_case_id JOIN automation_ui_execution e ON e.id = c.execution_id
WHERE st.id = #{stepExecutionDbId}
